blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The unexplained difference between Cale88 Foods Corp.’s reported sales and substantial bank inflows requires an accounting of both the sources and ultimate disposition of the money, with senator-judges seeking answers that government registration documents have yet to provide. Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon, a member of the House impeachment prosecution panel, said the defense must explain the company’s financial transactions rather than merely establish its legitimacy as a registered business. “Una, kanino galing iyon? Pangalawa, saan po iyon napunta?” Ridon asked. During the Nov. 20 impeachment hearing, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian confronted Board of Investments Managing Head […]...
